note: Ranges after owner feedback: MG 55 m (dense close-mid crowds), rifle 60 m (mid), sniper 220 m (long, isolated targets, quiet). Provisional playtest values (GAME_DESIGN.md 2, 14b). None of these numbers is approved by the owner. killReward.explosion > 0 is a provisional YES to OWNER question 1 (explosion kills pay); set it to 0 to pay soldier kills only.

ambient.note: UNAPPROVED. Idle city population and roaming (CityAmbient, sim_predict). densityPerHa: zombies per hectare of open ground; group chances per placed group; behaviour: wander speed m/s, pause fraction, alert memory s (dispersal after noise), separation, lurker / crawler fractions, drift-field wavelength m.

fort.note: UNAPPROVED (B2). Walls: price per 4 m piece, health, collision height (approved 1.6 / 2.4 m assets); pressure damage hp/s per zombie beyond the threshold. Territory: 1 m raster, income per controlled hectare, clear delay, loss time (PROPOSED breach rule). Gate (PROPOSED): price multiplier. Containers: parachute drop.

engineers.note: UNAPPROVED / PROPOSED (GAME_DESIGN 14d engineers, squad of 3 riflemen-engineers). Construction (walls, gates, gates placed into walls) and car clearing can only be ordered within radius m of an engineer squad; work in engineer-seconds per item (3 engineers work 3x as fast); carPrice per parked car cleared. workRange: m from the work spot; carSearch: click tolerance m.

structures.note: UNAPPROVED / PROPOSED (GAME_DESIGN 14e structures + fuel; owner decisions 2026-11-28: zombies attack the tower base and heap up around it, generator noise stacks per area). Prices; build times in engineer-seconds; tower: health, pressure damage hp/s per zombie at the base beyond the threshold, base half side m, obstacle top / deck height m, capacity, climb s, fall damage hp. Generator: tank l, burn l/s (+ per powered light), max lights, cable range m, fuel link range m to a fuel store, runs only at night (PROPOSED). Floodlight point light radius / intensity / height / reach m. Noise: per generator strength + reach; generators within noiseStackRadius add up (capped: noiseCap, noiseRadiusCap). Fuel: store capacity / start l, car fuel l, siphon engineer-seconds, jerrycan l per engineer trip, delivery range m.

rot.note: UNAPPROVED (GAME_DESIGN 14d corpse rot, APPROVED mechanic). Corpses start rotting after delay s and emit poison gas into a 2 m grid (emission ramps to full over ramp s: the gas spreads further the longer they stay); diffusion / decay per s; troops in gas above damageThreshold take damagePerSecond x level hp/s (capped); squads warn above warnLevel; soldier paths avoid cells above navAvoidLevel (extra cost).

flame.note: UNAPPROVED (GAME_DESIGN 14d flamethrower squad, size PROPOSED 2). Cone half angle deg; zombie damage / s in the cone; sprayed 2 m cells burn groundFireTime s (contained, no spread: PROPOSED); corpses ignite after corpseIgnite s of fire and burn corpseBurnTime s, then are gone (gas source removed). Autonomy: seeks piles (>= seekMinCorpses corpses per 2 m cell) or gas within seekRadius of its post. Fuel = weapons.flamethrower magazine / reserve (fuel units), resupplied from containers / crates (logistics fuel stock).

buildings.note: UNAPPROVED / PROPOSED (B3a). Capture: a squad holds an entrance with no zombie inside or at the door for captureTime s. Roles: Garrison / Hospital only (prices UNAPPROVED). Hospital beds and heal rate PROPOSED. Barricades: approved planks / plate / sandbags props, price and health per type; breachDps = zombie damage per s per zombie at an opening (CPU fallback until B3b).

vertical.note: UNAPPROVED (B3b): zombies in buildings. Interior graph door -> floor per storey (stair core) -> roof hatch; times in s, capacities in zombies; defenderDps = zombie health per s per soldier on that floor; routeWeight = door attractor reach lost per m of interior route. Barricade breach per zombie = buildings.breachDps.
